requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement mixes a functional action (raising a web alert) with an implied quality criterion (implied urgency or notification requirement). Per Pohl §25.2, it is decomposed into a functional requirement for the alert generation and a quality requirement regarding the alert's nature or delivery.

source_fragments: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.

fields.condition: a rejection order is received for a cancellation request

structured_requirements.final_statement: When a rejection order is received for a cancellation request, System-A must raise a web alert.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional action (raising the alert) from the concern-mixed sentence.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The web alert raised by System-A must serve as a valid notification mechanism.
structuring_notes: Extracted the implied quality criterion (that the alert must function as a notification) as a separate artefact.
